summary: Both full halves newly opened after restoration and inspected with the packet and detail crop. The first The has detached h marks, and the baseline punctuation under the etc insertion is partly covered. The cancelled as is legible. Section101 has a clear pen1 but the older zero-like digit remains doubtful. The pen an in abelianizators covers two unresolved older cells. There has typed t over T. The displayed f is pen over a p-like uncertain base, while its raised a has repeated type impressions. Commuting retains uncertainty on the b/c overprint order; in has n over b. Between is typed above the line. The old ed under inserting remains doubtful. The final of has pen o over an a-like uncertain base and a pen f retouch. The displaced typed star is linked to f by a pen placement cue. The arrows, carets, shrieks and all four diagram arrows are hand-drawn; their directions and diagram topology are unchanged.
